summary.intent: Apply the owner's decisions across the repos: merge three parallel agent worktree branches, then change the courier plugin so changesets follow the owner's changelog convention and Entire opens pull requests instead of courier.
summary.outcome: Merged the three worktree branches cleanly, updated the changesets reference, courier docs, Codex ship skill and courier CHANGELOG, and got `just check` to exit 0. Committed and pushed the change as feat(courier).

repo: Generated and synced artifacts are kept in step with sources via `just claude-manifests-sync` and `just marketplace-sync`; run both before `just check`.
`just check` is the validation gate; it can emit a word-count review warning on shared/references/delivery/changesets.md that does not fail validation.
Codex ship skill lives at harnesses/codex/plugins/guide/skills/ship/SKILL.md and is mirrored into dist/codex/plugins/guide/skills/ship/SKILL.md, so edits to one change both.
Courier plugin changes are recorded in plugins/courier/CHANGELOG.md under a dated version heading (e.g. `## [3.2.0] - 2026-11-14`, `### Changed`).

code.finding: This section holds the changeset format guidance that was rewritten to the owner's changelog convention: a bold lead-in, then short bullets with bold labels and a **Breaking** label when needed.
The text was reworded by an earlier harness fix, so a scripted anchor replace failed. It was patched afterward to say `courier:pr` lets Entire open the PR from the branch's trail.

workflow: Merging parallel agent worktree branches with `git merge --no-edit` and filtering the output for CONFLICT lines gives a quick check for clean merges.
Scripted text edits that assert `t.count(old)==1` fail loudly when an anchor has drifted. That makes it safe to apply batch edits and then patch the few that missed.
Re-running sync and check after merging, and before making further changes, gives a known-good baseline.

friction: The scripted edit's anchor for the Codex ship skill did not match because a prior harness fix had reworded it, so the edit needed a manual follow-up.
`just check` was run several times, and its output was filtered through grep and discarded, to extract both the failure details and the exit code.
open_items: The changesets reference triggers an existing word-count review warning that could be trimmed.
Courier opens a PR itself only where a repository says agents do; that opt-in behaviour is not verified in this session.
